name: AEA High Confidence
expression: (((D:AEA RD-FRD-Admonishment Phrase > 0) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD-Literal Phrase > 1)) OR ((D:AEA RD-FRD-Literal Phrase > 0) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD-Contextual Phrase > 0)) OR ((D:AEA RD-FRD-Portion-Marking-Pattern (High Confidence) > 2) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD Pattern (High Confidence) > 0)) OR ((D:AEA RD-FRD-Portion-Marking-Pattern (High Confidence) > 2) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD-Contextual Phrase > 0)))

name: AEA Medium Confidence
expression: (((D:AEA RD-FRD-Admonishment Phrase > 0) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD-Literal Phrase > 0)) OR ((D:AEA RD-FRD-Literal Phrase > 0) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD-Portion-Marking-Pattern (High Confidence) > 0)) OR ((D:AEA RD-FRD-Portion-Marking-Pattern (High Confidence) > 0) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD Pattern (Medium Confidence) > 0)) OR ((D:AEA RD-FRD-Portion-Marking-Pattern (Medium Confidence) > 0) AND (D:AEA RD-FRD-Contextual Phrase > 0)))

name: US PII
expression: ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 4) OR (D:Social Security Numbers (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Tax Identification Number (US) - High > 4) OR (D:Tax Identification Number (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 4) OR (D:Alien Registration Number - Prox 500 > 0) OR ((D:Date of Birth - High Confidence > 1) AND (D:Drivers License (United States) - High > 4)))

name: Private Keys
expression: ((D:Private Keys-Plaintext Regex > 0) OR (D:JWK Private Key > 0) OR (D:Private Key > 0) OR (D:Encrypted or ASCII Armored PGP Keys > 0) OR (D:Encrypted Bouncy Castle Key Exports > 0))

name: Financial Information
expression: ((D:ABA Bank Routing Number - High > 4) OR (D:ABA Bank Routing Number - Prox 500 > 1) OR (D:Credit Cards - High > 4) OR (D:Credit Cards - Prox 500 > 1) OR (D:Credit Card Magnetic Tracks > 0) OR (D:ML_TAX_LEAKAGE > 0) OR (D:Form K-1 > 3) OR (D:Form 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC > 4) OR (D:W2 or W4 or W9 Forms > 3) OR (D:Form 1040 and related schedules > 3) OR (D:FINANCIAL > 0) OR (D:ML_CORPORATE_FINANCE_LEAKAGE > 0))

name: US PHI - Medium Confidence
expression: (((D:ML_MEDICAL_DOC_LEAKAGE > 0) OR ((D:MEDICAL > 0) AND ((D:DRUGS_LEAKAGE > 9) OR (D:DISEASES_LEAKAGE > 9)))) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 0) OR (D:US Passport - High Confidence > 0) OR (D:Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 0) OR ((D:Date of Birth - High Confidence > 0) AND (D:Drivers License (United States) - Prox 500 > 0))))

name: US PHI - High Confidence
expression: (((D:ML_MEDICAL_DOC_LEAKAGE > 0) OR ((D:MEDICAL > 0) AND ((D:DRUGS_LEAKAGE > 14) OR (D:DISEASES_LEAKAGE > 14)))) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 4) OR (D:US Passport - High Confidence > 4) OR (D:Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 4) OR ((D:Date of Birth - Prox 500 > 1) AND (D:Drivers License (United States) - Prox 500 > 1)) OR (D:Social Security Numbers (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:US Passport - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:Alien Registration Number - Prox 500 > 0)))

name: CUI Engine (High Confidence)
expression: ((D:CUI Registry Marking Pattern (High confidence) > 0) OR (D:CUI Portion Marking Pattern (High confidence) > 1) OR (D:Declassify Date Pattern (High Confidence) > 0))

name: CUI Engine (Medium Confidence)
expression: (((D:CUI Registry Marking Pattern (Medium confidence) > 0) AND ((D:CUI Portion Marking Pattern (Medium confidence) > 0) OR (D:CUI Contextual Phrases > 0) OR (D:CUI Category Phrase > 0))) OR ((D:CUI Portion Marking Pattern (Medium confidence) > 0) AND ((D:CUI Contextual Phrases > 2) OR (D:CUI Category Phrase > 1))) OR ((D:Declassify Date Pattern (Medium Confidence) > 0) AND ((D:CUI Portion Marking Pattern (Medium confidence) > 0) OR (D:CUI Contextual Phrases > 2) OR (D:CUI Category Phrase > 1))))
